correctness.rationale: If n is odd, ternary prodigious n has no digit 2, hence n mod9 in {0,1,3,4} and at most 2 consecutive step-two odd terms. For even n with n=2 mod4, two 2 digits among three lowest ternary positions force 4|p3(n) but 4∤n. The exact CRT classes are {26,50,62,74,78,98,106} mod108, spaced by even step indices with maximum cyclic gap 14, so every 14-term even run hits one forbidden class. Independent exhaustive check of all 54 even residue starts and 9 odd residues reproduced this obstruction. Direct digit products of 108,110,...,132 equal [1,2,1,2,4,1,1,2,2,2,4,2,4] and divide each term. Adding 4*3^K for every K>=5 prepends two unit digits with no carry and preserves all divisibility, proving infinitely many sharp progressions. The universal claim follows from residue argument, not an unbounded scan.
